        The effect each bar state shows. Progress, the animated progress and the barber pole all draw the print percentage, so they need a printer bound and a print running to show anything.

        Presets
        A named copy of an effect. Save the state you are editing, then apply it to another state or to a print stage.
          Print stages
          An effect per stage of a print. A stage left inheriting shows whatever the printing state shows.
            Stage images
            A GIF for each stage of a print, played on the bar while that stage runs.
            Each row of the image becomes one frame across the strip. Held in memory, so it is gone after a restart.
              Lights
              One colour per segment of the bar, as the device reports its segments. It is stored and reported back, and nothing draws it yet: what a segment maps to on the strip is not established. The effects above are what the bar shows.

                The page you are looking at
              Power
              A factory reset erases the Wi-Fi credentials, the printer binding and every light setting. It cannot be undone from here.
              Features
              Everything here is off on a new device. Each switch turns on one addition and nothing else changes.
                Settings file
                Every setting as one file, to keep or to copy onto another unit. No passwords and no access code are in it, so put those back by hand after restoring.
                Bind to a printer
                This device finds Bambu printers on the same network. Pick yours and it fills in the serial; the access code is on the printer's own screen.
                Network
                Type this address into a browser on any device on the same network to open this page again.
                • Address
                • Signal
                Host name
                A name is easier to remember than an address and survives the router handing out a different one.
                Adding .local to this name reaches this device from anything on the network.
                Fixed address
                Pick an address your router will not hand to anything else. It takes effect the next time this device joins the network.
                Use a fixed address
                Optional
                This device's own network
                Connect to this from a phone or laptop when this device is not on your Wi-Fi, then open the address below.
                • Hotspot on
                  Always on, so you can always reach this device. Changing the name, the password or this switch drops you if you are connected through it.
                Leave this alone unless it clashes with something on your network.
